title: Bangladesh government reviewing objectionable provisions of its Cyber Security Act, Law Minister says
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (24 November); the minister's remarks are reported as made after a consultation meeting that day.
geo_basis: national government of Bangladesh; Dhaka is where the reported consultation meeting at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was held
summary: Daily Naya Diganta reports that Law Minister Md. Asaduzzaman said the government is reviewing objectionable provisions of the Cyber Security Act, after a consultation meeting with foreign diplomats and stakeholders. Stakeholders were asked to send further written recommendations within one week. The minister said the Prime Minister sent the law back from cabinet for review because it involves freedom of expression.
plain: Bangladesh's law minister says the government is reviewing objectionable parts of its Cyber Security Act and has asked for written suggestions within one week, Daily Naya Diganta reports.
exec: Bangladesh's Cyber Security Act is under government review, per the Law Minister quoted by Daily Naya Diganta; stakeholders were asked to send recommendations within one week.

validation.note: One publisher (Daily Naya Diganta, Bengali) read; it quotes the Law Minister's own statement. No second publisher read.

review.note: Compared title, date, one-week request, PM sent back from cabinet, single-source against Daily Naya Diganta
